name: Toyotomi Hideyoshi
source:
Hobby: Meddling
Special Skill: Calligraphy
Charm Point: His sexy eyes

Nobunaga's retainer. Due to his helpful and caring manner, he is popular with everyone he meets, especially ladies. Fiercely loyal to Nobunaga, he initially considers you a threat.

"Just follow my lead. I won't let anything happen to you."

[from the app]
